description: arpspoof-style poisoning: the attacker tells 10.1.1.10 every 2s that the gateway 10.1.1.1 is at 02:00:00:00:00:66, and the real gateway answers the victim's request every 10s. The binding flips back and forth: flip_flop fires on the third return to a known MAC (10s in), every change is a mac_change, and the attacker replies more than 5s after a request are unsolicited (5 within 30s).
